sources.quote: TOI-4507 b is an exoplanet discovered in October 2025 that is roughly 578 light-years away.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around TOI-4507. Its orbit and size follow Espinoza-Retamal et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
